title: Hyderabad, India-based Equal AI, which makes an eponymous AI-powered call screening app, raised a $30M Series B led by Prosus Ventures and Tomales Bay Capital (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: Hyderabad, India-based Equal AI, which makes an eponymous AI-powered call screening app, raised a $30M Series B led by Prosus Ventures and Tomales Bay Capital — In India, consumers receive a lot of calls every day, ranging from spam and scams to delivery people and financial service companies trying to contact them.
